name: Resident definition builder
description: Processes requested builds of natural-language net definitions unattended (design doc: resident builders). Every tick a deterministic check reads the model's catalogue; only when a build is queued, or waits for answers that are now all given, headless Claude Code runs the realize-net-definition protocol through this MCP server. Ships OFF: nothing spends quota until enabled. Requires an executor that can reach the gateway, the claude CLI, and a Claude Code MCP config naming this server.

model.description: Model whose definitions this builder works on

owner.description: Builder id recorded on leases and logs

gatewayUrl.description: Gateway base URL reachable from the executor

secretFile.description: Executor-visible file holding the gateway admin client secret

mcpConfig.description: Claude Code MCP config (JSON) that declares this Agentic-Nets MCP server

mcpServer.description: Server name inside that MCP config

enabled.description: true to let the builder act; false keeps every tick a no-op

args.command:
set -u
if [ "${DB_ENABLED:-false}" != "true" ]; then echo "resident builder for $DB_MODEL is off: set args.env.DB_ENABLED to true in its command token"; exit 0; fi
for v in DB_MODEL DB_GATEWAY DB_SECRET_FILE DB_MCP_CONFIG DB_OWNER; do eval "x=\${$v:-}"; [ -n "$x" ] || { echo "missing $v" >&2; exit 64; }; done
command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "claude CLI is unavailable on this executor" >&2; exit 127; }
SECRET_FILE="${DB_SECRET_FILE/#\~/$HOME}"
SECRET=$(tr -d '\n' < "$SECRET_FILE") || { echo "cannot read $SECRET_FILE" >&2; exit 66; }
TOKEN=$(curl -sf -m 15 -X POST "$DB_GATEWAY/oauth2/token" --data-urlencode client_id=agenticos-admin --data-urlencode "client_secret=$SECRET" --data-urlencode grant_type=client_credentials | python3 -I -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])') || { echo "token mint failed" >&2; exit 69; }
PICK=$(curl -sf -m 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$DB_GATEWAY/api/explorer/$DB_MODEL/catalogue?modelId=$DB_MODEL" | python3 -I -c '
import sys, json
cat = json.load(sys.stdin)
for d in cat.get("definitions", []):
    if d.get("status") == "archived":
        continue
    if d.get("latestBuildState") in ("queued", "awaiting-answers"):
        print(d["key"], d.get("latestBuildId") or "-", d["latestBuildState"])
        break
') || { echo "catalogue read failed" >&2; exit 69; }
if [ -z "$PICK" ]; then echo "no queued build in $DB_MODEL"; exit 0; fi
set -- $PICK; KEY=$1; BUILD=$2; STATE=$3
if [ "$STATE" = "awaiting-answers" ]; then
  OPEN=$(curl -sf -m 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$DB_GATEWAY/api/explorer/$DB_MODEL/definitions/${KEY%%::*}/${KEY#*::}?modelId=$DB_MODEL" | python3 -I -c 'import sys,json; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)["questions"]["open"]))') || OPEN=1
  if [ "$OPEN" != "0" ]; then echo "$KEY waits for $OPEN answer(s)"; exit 0; fi
fi
PROMPT="You are the resident builder $DB_OWNER for model $DB_MODEL. Realize the net definition $KEY (build $BUILD) with the $DB_MCP_SERVER MCP tools, following the definitions knowledge topic (search_knowledge definitions). claim_net_definition claim as owner $DB_OWNER; read get_net_definition and explore_model; when a material question is open or needed, ask it through application_action on interview ask with subjectKind net-definition, subjectKey $KEY and buildId, checkpoint awaiting-answers and stop. Otherwise checkpoint a plan with reusedPlaces and assumptions, apply with nothing started, verify with verify_inscription, and complete with evidence, or fail with the reason. On lease-lost, superseded or cancel-requested stop at once. Never create a second net. Reply with one line: the outcome."
echo "[$DB_OWNER] building $KEY ($BUILD, $STATE)"
printf '%s\n' "$PROMPT" | claude -p --mcp-config "$DB_MCP_CONFIG" --allowedTools "mcp__$DB_MCP_SERVER" --no-session-persistence
